name: Unbound Potential
description: Increases your Damage, Armour, and Energy Shield. Lost when Shapeshifting back into a Human.
keywordDefinition:
Each Unbound Potential grants 20% increased Damage, 10% increased Armour, and 10% increased Energy Shield. You can have up to 10 Unbound Potential, and will lose one every 5 seconds.

Lose all Unbound Potential when you Shapeshift into a Human.
